SELECT FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST r WHERE r.MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND r.CHANGE_SOURCE = 'MANUAL' AND r.SUBMIT_TIME IS NOT NULL AND r.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND r.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST_ITEM i WHERE i.REQUEST_ID = r.ID AND (i.MASTER_RECORD_ID = #{masterRecordId} OR i.RESULT_MASTER_RECORD_ID = #{masterRecordId}) AND i.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND i.DEL_FLAG = '0')
ORDER BY r.ID ASCDESC
ORDER BY r.SUBMIT_TIME DESC, r.ID DESC

SELECT FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST r WHERE r.ID = #{requestId} AND r.MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND r.CHANGE_SOURCE = 'MANUAL' AND r.SUBMIT_TIME IS NOT NULL AND r.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND r.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST_ITEM i WHERE i.REQUEST_ID = r.ID AND (i.MASTER_RECORD_ID = #{masterRecordId} OR i.RESULT_MASTER_RECORD_ID = #{masterRecordId}) AND i.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND i.DEL_FLAG = '0')

SELECT FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST r WHERE r.MODEL_ID = #{query.modelId} AND r.CHANGE_SOURCE = 'MANUAL' AND r.SUBMIT_TIME IS NOT NULL AND r.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND r.DEL_FLAG = '0'
AND r.CHANGE_TYPE = #{query.changeType}
AND r.STATUS = #{query.approvalStatus}
AND LOWER(r.REQUEST_NAME) LIKE #{query.requestNameLike} ESCAPE '!'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST_ITEM ki WHERE ki.REQUEST_ID = r.ID AND ki.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND ki.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND (ki.MASTER_RECORD_ID = #{query.masterDataId} OR ki.RESULT_MASTER_RECORD_ID = #{query.masterDataId}))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST_ITEM ci WHERE ci.REQUEST_ID = r.ID AND ci.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND ci.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND (
(ci.MASTER_RECORD_ID IN #{recordId} OR ci.RESULT_MASTER_RECORD_ID IN #{recordId})
))
ORDER BY r.ID ASCDESC
ORDER BY r.SUBMIT_TIME ASCDESC, r.ID ASCDESC
ORDER BY r.ID DESC
SELECT FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST r WHERE r.ID = #{requestId} AND r.MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND r.CHANGE_SOURCE = 'MANUAL' AND r.SUBMIT_TIME IS NOT NULL AND r.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND r.DEL_FLAG = '0'

SELECT STATUS, COUNT(1) AS ROW_COUNT FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST WHERE MODEL_ID = #{modelId} AND CHANGE_SOURCE = 'MANUAL' AND SUBMIT_TIME IS NOT NULL AND VALID_FLAG = '1' AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY STATUS

SELECT r.STATUS, COUNT(1) AS ROW_COUNT FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST r
GROUP BY r.STATUS

SELECT r.ID, r.REQUEST_NO, r.REQUEST_NAME, r.APPLY_REASON, r.MODEL_ID, r.INSTANCE_ID, r.EXECUTION_ID, r.CHANGE_TYPE, r.STATUS, r.EXECUTE_STATUS, r.SUBMIT_TIME, r.FINISH_TIME, r.EXECUTE_MESSAGE, r.FLOW_INSTANCE_ID, r.ITEM_COUNT FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST r
AND r.STATUS = '0'
AND r.STATUS <> '0'
ORDER BY r.ID
ASC DESC
ORDER BY r.SUBMIT_TIME
ASC DESC
, r.ID DESC
ORDER BY r.SUBMIT_TIME DESC, r.ID DESC

SELECT DISTINCT r.MODEL_ID FROM MASTER_CHANGE_REQUEST r WHERE r.APPLICANT_ID = #{applicantId} AND r.CHANGE_SOURCE IN ('MANUAL', 'MERGE') AND r.SUBMIT_TIME IS NOT NULL AND r.VALID_FLAG = '1' AND r.DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY r.MODEL_ID
